question: Estimate the reach of a regional Tamil-language influencer campaign with 20 mid-tier influencers (100K-1M followers each).
idealClarificationQuestions: Sponsored posts/reels on Instagram + YouTube? Yes — both.
Mid-tier Tamil influencers (food, fashion, tech, lifestyle mix)? Yes.
Total unique reach (deduped across influencers)? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Sum of follower bases × engagement reach × deduplication.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: 20 influencers × avg 400K followers each = 80 lakh combined follower base (but heavy overlap among Tamil audiences).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: If 2 posts per influencer over campaign: 48 lakh impressions.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Round: ~25-30 lakh unique Tamil-speaking users reached.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: If 2 posts per influencer over campaign

calculationFlow: 20 influencers × avg 400K followers each = 80 lakh combined follower base (but heavy overlap among Tamil audiences).
Of these, average reach per sponsored post (Instagram organic reach ~25-35% of followers): ~30% = 24 lakh impressions per round.
If 2 posts per influencer over campaign: 48 lakh impressions.
Plus YouTube integrations (longer-form reach): adds ~5-7 lakh views.
Unique audience deduplication (Tamil-speaking IG/YT user base is small ~2 crore active; influencer overlap is high): unique reach ~25-30 lakh.
Round: ~25-30 lakh unique Tamil-speaking users reached.
